description: Grant one member's key one api path (a branch, or a branch and its verb): {key, label, path}. The label is the name the table already holds for that key, or else what your contacts call it, or else empty. Refused bad-request without a key and a path, not-a-path (400) when the path is no branch path, already-granted (409) when the key already holds it, and unknown-path (404) when no server serves the path and no earlier grant names it.
